jobs.description:
Our plant Henri van de Bilt in Beuningen is looking for a Buyer (m/f/d).

What your job includes

As a Buyer, you are responsible for purchasing and calling off products, materials, and services for the factory from suppliers, manufacturers, and wholesalers both domestically and internationally. You maintain good relationships with suppliers and monitor their performance.

- Daily processing of purchase proposals and orders for raw materials and goods
- Organizing the local purchasing and ordering process
- Determining and organizing delivery times, order quantities, and order schedules
- Monitoring and checking the nature, quantity, and quality of the ordered goods
- Handling and following up on complaints when delivered goods do not meet expectations
- Maintaining master data related to purchasing-relevant information
- Performing other tasks as directed by the supervisor

What we expect from you

- Strong coordination and organizational skills 
- Good negotiation skills, a professional demeanor, and persuasiveness
- Analytical insight
- Creative and solution-oriented mindset
- Good team spirit and ability to collaborate
- Excellent skills in MS Office and ERP systems
- Fluency in English and Dutch

What We Offer You

We are a company with flat hierarchies, strong values, and a clear focus on our customers. We know that our employees are the key to our success. That is why we quickly give you responsibility and help you grow according to your talents.

- A responsible role within the purchasing and ordering process
- A professional work environment where you collaborate with various internal and external parties
- A position with international contacts with suppliers
- A work environment where accuracy, organization, and collaboration are central

Soldering operator

Working as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.

As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.

Your tasks are, amongst others:

· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings

· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series

· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards

· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspection

You will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.

What Benchmark has to offer to you:

· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.

· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.

· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.

· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.

· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.

· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.

What do we ask of you?

· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.

· Being able to work very precise and accurate.

· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.

· Good knowledge of either the Dutch or English language.

About Benchmark:

Benchmark in Almelo is part of the multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., a listed company in the field of manufacturing electronics and providing services to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

At Benchmark you work for companies that make an impact with their innovations. We develop new products that improve safety or health or increase convenience. These products are supplied from product design to volume production and sometimes directly to the end user. This entire process, from design to production, is carried out entirely in Almelo.

Globally, Benchmark Electronics Inc. currently has 23 locations. In Almelo, the Netherlands, you will be working with up to 750 colleagues.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber: 
Grundkenntnisse: Wartung, Reparatur, Instandhaltung
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Feinlöten, Hartlöten, Löten, Weichlöten, Maschinenführung, Anlagenführung, -bedienung

Welding Robot Operator

The company is looking for a Welding Robot Operator for the robotics department. In this role, you will be responsible for the automated welding process of high-quality stainless steel welded assemblies and will also perform various metalworking tasks. You will work in a production team with one or more welding robots, assessing and reworking products as needed. As a robot operator, you will monitor the functioning of the welding robots and the welding quality. The welds will be visually inspected, and any deviations will be monitored and discussed to ensure continuous process improvement. The plate thickness varies between 2 and 5 mm.
Team
There are different products: box frames, center arms, fences and grates, central units and boiler frames, collectors, M4use.
 What Will You Be Doing? 
▪ Operating and configuring the welding robot 
▪ Monitoring product quality 
▪ Improvement
What skills Do You need?
▪ You can weld in both Mig/Mag and Tig modes.
▪ Experience with welding robots.
▪ You are fluent in English.
▪ You are motivated and can work accurately.

What does the company offer?
    Salary between 20-21 euros gross/hour for 38 hours/week. With overtime (depending on client’s requirement): You can earn between 700-800 euros net/week (excluding housing and health insurance).
    Single Private Room in shared house
    Shared Company car or Travel allowance
    Weekly payment and long-term contract

AT The Family Business: 
    They have a close and friendly team where teamwork is key.
    They work with the best materials and state-of-the-art machinery in the safest and most organized work environment. They value order and cleanliness. 
    They manufacture high-quality products for special clients

The Analytical Center of Excellence (ACE) organization is looking for a 
Junior Analytical Technician 
(full shift) in the Chemicals lab located in Terneuzen, The Netherlands.
 

The Chemicals lab in is one of the Manufacturing Production Quality (MPQ) labs that performs analysis of plant-samples in Terneuzen. Servings multiple production plants such as polyurethanes and polyglycols results in the need for a 24/7 service and a full-shift roster to perform the analysis of all plant samples.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Ensure service requests are accurately run, and the data returned as per sample plan. 

• Analytical equipment operations and troubleshooting as per procedures. 

• Provide input of quality data into LIMS, document and communicate results. 

• Perform calibration and first line-maintenance of analytical equipment. Document/administrate these maintenance activities. Communicate maintenance work when required. 

• Apply Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), Analytical Work Process and Operating Discipline/Quality System procedures and practices as well as cGMP/pharma standards. 

• Participating in and completing of laboratory training and corporate required trainings. 

• Co-operate and communicate with co-workers and clients to maintain workflow and instrumental information, and to share and leverage problem solving and prevention expertise. 

• Contribute to value creation by continuous improvement of procedures in the analytical work processes and related tools and performance metrics. 

• Promote a well-organized, responsive, efficient workplace and work well both as a team member and independently. 

Qualifications
 
 

• MBO-4 laboratory degree or similar (bachelors degree preferred). 

• Fluent in Dutch and English. 

• Experience in an industrial laboratory (analytical) 

• Able to work in full shift (24/7 roster): morning, afternoon and night shifts.  

 
 

Preferred qualifications
 
 

• GMP/pharma experience. 

• Experience in operation, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of analytical equipment. 

• Knowledge of quality data systems like LIMS, OpenLab, etc. 

• Good lab techniques, methodical record keeping, and the ability to work both independently and with co-workers. 

• Excellent human relations, organizational and communication skills are necessary to communicate with team members, partners and outside customers. 

• Exhibit confidence in confirming validity of methods and data. 

• Able to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.

Production Employee 5-Shift System Zevenaar

As a production employee in a 5-shift system in Zevenaar, you will work in a dynamic environment where no days are the same.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the production process. You start your day with a brief handover from the previous shift, after which you operate and check the machines. Throughout the day, you monitor the quality of the products and resolve any issues. You ensure that the products are packed and prepared for shipment.

You will be working at a leading manufacturing company in Zevenaar. The organization is known for its innovative approach and strong focus on quality. With a team of committed employees, they strive to deliver the best products. The work atmosphere is informal and focused on collaboration, with plenty of room for personal development. 

Requirements

- Experience in a production environment
- Forklift and reach truck certificate is a plus
- Team-oriented collaboration
- Good communication skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Knowledge of safety regulations
- Good command of Dutch or English

- Salary €17.50 per hour excluding shift allowance

jobs.occupation: Data Functional Analyst – SQL Server & Power BI
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead discussions with business subject matter experts to identify and understand data-related needs and business processes.
• Translate business requirements into detailed functional and technical specifications for data flows and solutions.
• Design and validate conceptual and logical data models in close collaboration with data architects.
• Develop functional designs for business intelligence developments in alignment with data governance and technical leads.
• Liaise with data protection officers to ensure all solutions comply with GDPR and security standards.
• Coordinate the testing of data products and facilitate user training to encourage adoption.

Requirements

• You bring 5+ years of experience in data functional analysis and data warehouse modelling using the Kimball approach.
• You possess 3+ years of experience with the Microsoft on-premise stack, specifically SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, and Power BI.
• You have a proven track record in analyzing and designing complex operational and analytics data flows.
• You're able to demonstrate strong data literacy and a conceptual understanding of business processes.
• You bring a proactive, can-do attitude with a strong sense of ownership and autonomy.
• You possess excellent problem-solving skills and a pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset.
• You have professional communication and presentation skills.
• You are fluent in French and Dutch with active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Prior experience working as a data engineer.
• Experience with Azure Databricks.

Responsibilities

• Model business processes and guide stakeholders through the redesign of operational workflows.
• Identify business needs and translate them into structured requirements, such as epics and user stories.
• Bridge the gap between business users and IT partners by challenging requirements and validating functional analyses.
• Harmonize business processes across different departments and international sister organizations.
• Oversee the testing and validation of new software releases post-implementation.
• Support change management by developing training materials and conducting sessions for end-users.

Requirements

• You have a Master’s degree in a technical or economic field or equivalent through experience.
• You bring 5+ years of experience in business analysis, requirement elicitation, and process modeling.
• You possess advanced knowledge of BPMN and UML.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and the ability to challenge stakeholders to reach a consensus.
• You're proficient in planning and organizational management within complex project environments.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) or a willingness to learn.
• Knowledge of tools such as Enterprise Architect, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
• Professional background in the electricity sector or industrial asset maintenance.

Responsibilities

• Assess the quality of documentation and implementation evidence provided by internal domains based on security guidance.
• Validate that provided evidence supports self-evaluation scores and is not based on assumptions.
• Provide structured feedback and concrete improvement points to domain owners.
• Build comprehensive audit dossiers and evidence registers for external verification.
• Interpret technical evidence including configuration exports, log files, tickets, and scan reports.
• Support the organization in achieving and maintaining required security maturity levels.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in information security, compliance, or IT audit.
• You possess deep knowledge of security frameworks such as CyFun, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF.
• You bring experience in a second-line security role focusing on validation and oversight.
• You're able to analyze technical data like logs, vulnerability scans, and system configurations.
• You are native in Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with CyFun implementations specifically for essential organizations.
• Knowledge of English.
